BiblicalUsage: Harisuth is demolition, the wreckage itself, and it appears once, in a verse that turns the wreckage into a crowd. In Isaiah 49:19 the waste places and the desolate places and the land of destruction shall even now be too narrow for the inhabitants, because the children are coming home.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is one of the most hopeful in Isaiah: the ruined land will be too small for the people God brings back to it.
